concepts.name: CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory (Unit 6)
concepts.simple_definition: CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory is a core topic in Grade 9 Information technology covering essential principles on pages 181-210.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ሲፒዩ (CPU)፣ ራም (RAM) እና ሮም (ROM) ሜሞሪ በ9ኛ ክፍል ኢንፎርሜሽን ቴክኖሎጂ (IT) መጽሐፍ ገጽ 181-210 ላይ የተሸፈነ መሠረታዊ የትምህርት ርዕስ ነው።

concepts.real_example: Practical academic or real-world application of CPU Hardware and RAM ROM Memory.
concepts.real_example_amharic: በሲፒዩ (CPU)፣ ራም (RAM) እና ሮም (ROM) ሜሞሪ ትምህርት ውስጥ የሚታይ ተግባራዊና ሳይንሳዊ ምሳሌ።
